thread:
maria: HW partner confirmed GPU-credit allotment. They want marketplace listing + blog + press all live same time. Need timing, CTA mapping, legal on promo terms. :rocket:

devin: timeline question 1: do they have a fixed date? we need at least 72h for canary + 24h for smoke.

maria: they asked for Tue 2026-06-09 10:00 PT. That gives 9 days. doable?

sam: marketing can hit that if blog + quotes ready by Thu. blog draft in progress 1 will share link. need partner quote Thu EOD.

kevin: PR: we need embargo plan. partner expects coordinated announcement. who drafts the joint release?

alisha: design: will finalize hero + partner badge. need partner logo SVG and brand colors. CTA: can we use "Try with partner credits"?

maria: CTA must map to marketplace SKU with promo_token param so credits apply automatically. vikram, can marketplace accept promo_token?

vikram: yes. marketplace accepts ?promo_token= to apply credit record. token format + TTL needed. suggest 48h TTL. Also SI needs small activation webhook.

maria: tony (legal), any issues with credits + TTL? consumer T&Cs required?

tony: legal ok with simple promo terms: expiry date, one-per-customer, non-transferable. partner asked 30d; we recommend 14d to reduce abuse. will draft T&Cs blurb.

sam: 14d fine. marketing will add FAQ and UTM: utm_source=partner&utm_campaign=marketplace_launch.

maria: partner wants co-marketing assets: co-auth blog, press quote, landing takeover for 24h. propose sequence: (1) publish listing, (2) blog live, (3) embargo lifts. thoughts?

kevin: embargo must match publish time. if listing goes live slightly earlier for signup flow, press embargo time must be identical.

alisha: takeover vs inline banner? takeover needs frontend slot and schedule.

vikram: frontend supports scheduled takeover via feature flag. ops can toggle. recommend feature-flag at T-2m enable at T.

maria: deploy-bot please schedule flag toggle.

deploy-bot: scheduled: feature-flag "partner_takeover_20260609" -> enable 2026-06-09T10:00:00-07:00, pre-toggle at 09:58.

sam: marketing checklist: blog draft (sam) Thu; partner quote Thu EOD; press release (kevin) Fri AM; social + images (alisha/sam) Fri PM; embargo docs (kevin/tony) Fri EOD.

vikram: eng checklist: SKU in staging Mon; promo_token integration test Tue T-1; webhook handshake Tue T-1; feature-flag schedule Tue T-2h. I'll post HMAC example in #eng-runtime.

maria: owners: maria (orchestration), devin (launch ops), sam (marketing), kevin (PR), alisha (design), tony (legal), vikram (engineering). Dry-run next Mon 2026-05-31 10:00 PT.

devin: I'll send calendar invite with partner reps.

kevin: partner requested embargoed CEO quote + headshot. maria, can you get it by Thu?

maria: yes.

alisha: note: need partner-approved logo SVG before Fri to avoid delays.

vikram: technical note: promo_token must be validated by signature. proposing HMAC_SHA256(base64(token), secret). will share details in eng channel.

tony: legal will draft T&Cs and a one-paragraph joint statement guideline for PR.

maria: summary posted to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketplace/hw-partner-launch with checklist. Next check: Mon 2026-05-31 10:00 PT (dry-run). :eyes:
